info_intro.name: About
info_intro.hint: Web search plugin with dual engines: Tavily and AnySearch. Hybrid mode queries both sources concurrently, then deduplicates and ranks results using RRF and normalized score weighting. Create a free AnySearch API key at https://anysearch.com/console/api-keys, or leave it blank for anonymous access (1,000 free requests per day).

zh.name: 说明
zh.hint: 联网搜索插件：Tavily / AnySearch 双引擎。hybrid 混合模式会并发调用两个源并按相关性融合排序去重（RRF + 归一化 score 加权）。AnySearch Key 可在 https://anysearch.com/console/api-keys 免费创建，留空则匿名访问（每日 1000 次免费额度）。

search_provider.name: Search Mode
search_provider.hint: hybrid = query both sources concurrently and merge (recommended, auto-falls back to single source if one is unavailable, equivalent to legacy auto); tavily/anysearch = force single source

zh.name: 搜索模式
zh.hint: hybrid=双源并发混合返回（推荐，任一源不可用自动降级单源，等效旧 auto）；tavily/anysearch=强制单源

tavily_key.name: Tavily Key
tavily_key.hint: Your Tavily key, create one in https://app.tavily.com/home

zh.name: Tavily 密钥
zh.hint: 你的 Tavily 密钥，在 https://app.tavily.com/home 创建

anysearch_key.name: AnySearch Key
anysearch_key.hint: AnySearch API Key (starts with as_sk_). Leave blank to use anonymous access (1,000 free requests per day, lower rate limit)

zh.name: AnySearch 密钥
zh.hint: AnySearch API Key（as_sk_ 开头）。留空则匿名访问（每日 1000 次，限流较低）

anysearch_base_url.name: AnySearch API Base URL
anysearch_base_url.hint: Default official endpoint, usually no need to change

zh.name: AnySearch API 地址
zh.hint: 默认官方地址，一般无需修改

max_results.name: Max Results
max_results.hint: Number of results returned for a single search (1-10); in hybrid mode this is the count after fusion and deduplication

zh.name: 最大结果数
zh.hint: 单次搜索最终返回的结果条数（1-10），hybrid 模式下为融合去重后的条数

hybrid_score_weight.name: Hybrid Score Weight
hybrid_score_weight.hint: Weight of the normalized score when fusing in hybrid mode; the rest goes to the RRF rank score. 0 = pure RRF, 1 = pure score

zh.name: 混合打分权重
zh.hint: hybrid 融合时 score 归一化权重，其余归 RRF 排名分。0=纯 RRF，1=纯 score
